svg.title: Martin Lema — a pixel coast at daybreak
svg.desc: Animated coast, layered mountains, drifting clouds, wing-flapping gulls, a robin perched on the name and a blue-orange kingfisher by the sea.

g.text: M / L • FIELD NOTES FROM SWITZERLAND
CODE, CURIOSITY & A LITTLE WILD WONDER.
A SMALL WORLD. AN OPEN MIND.
